question: What is the main goal of psychiatric rehabilitation?

options.A: To keep patients in hospital care permanently
options.B: To isolate patients from their families forever
options.C: To cure mental illness using only herbal remedies
options.D: To help patients return to meaningful community life

explanation: You got this! Psychiatric rehabilitation is all about helping individuals with long-term mental health challenges regain their independence and live fulfilling lives back in society. [learn more](GNS314_U5_T4#GNS314_U5_T4_h1)

question: What does 'institutionalism' mean in mental health care?

options.A: The strict enforcement of hospital visiting hours for family members
options.B: The process of building new psychiatric hospitals in rural areas
options.C: The loss of independent living skills from long hospital stays
options.D: The successful graduation of patients into independent apartments

explanation: Spot on! When patients stay in a hospital for too long, they can become overly dependent on staff and lose confidence in caring for themselves. We call this institutionalism. [learn more](GNS314_U5_T4#GNS314_U5_T4_h1)

question: What is a half-way house primarily designed to be?

options.A: A high-security prison for individuals with criminal records
options.B: A transitional residential facility for recovering individuals
options.C: An acute emergency ward for violent psychiatric patients
options.D: A permanent housing estate for elderly retired nurses

explanation: Great job! A half-way house acts as a gentle stepping stone between intensive hospital care and fully independent living in the community. [learn more](GNS314_U5_T4#GNS314_U5_T4_h2)

question: How do half-way houses differ from traditional psychiatric wards?

options.A: They do not allow any staff members to visit the premises
options.B: They force residents to stay indoors without any contact with family
options.C: They avoid locked doors and focus on peer support and responsibility
options.D: They provide major surgeries and emergency blood transfusions

explanation: Exactly! Unlike restrictive hospital wards, half-way houses focus on personal growth, peer support, and living without heavy medical restraints. [learn more](GNS314_U5_T4#GNS314_U5_T4_h2)

question: Which residential model features 24-hour staff presence for high support?
explanation: Well done! Supervised hostels have staff around the clock to give extra guidance to residents who still need help with daily routines and medications. [learn more](GNS314_U5_T4#GNS314_U5_T4_h3)

question: A patient is nearly ready for independent life and only needs short-term guidance on budgeting and job hunting. Which facility fits best?
explanation: You nailed it! Transitional facilities are short-term setups designed to help patients brush up on practical skills like managing money and finding jobs before they head out on their own. [learn more](GNS314_U5_T4#GNS314_U5_T4_h3)

question: Which group makes up the primary target population for half-way houses?

options.A: Healthy university students needing affordable accommodation
options.B: Patients experiencing acute and violent psychotic episodes
options.C: Children recovering from routine surgical procedures
options.D: Clinically stable individuals with chronic mental illness

explanation: Spot on! Half-way houses are ideal for people whose acute symptoms are well-controlled, but who still benefit from a supportive environment while they practice independent living. [learn more](GNS314_U5_T4#GNS314_U5_T4_h4)

question: What is a standard admission rule for most half-way houses?

options.A: Requirement to work at least forty hours per week immediately
options.B: Promise never to communicate with family members again
options.C: Ability to pay for private medical insurance out of pocket
options.D: Willingness to follow house rules and remain substance-free

explanation: That's correct! To keep the living space safe and healing for everyone, residents agree to stay off illicit substances and respect the facility rules. [learn more](GNS314_U5_T4#GNS314_U5_T4_h4)

question: Why is a predictable daily routine important in a half-way house?

options.A: It promotes stability and reduces anxiety for residents
options.B: It replaces the need for any medication or therapy
options.C: It ensures that nurses have less paperwork to complete
options.D: It punishes residents who wake up late in the morning

explanation: Great thinking! Structure and predictability help individuals with mental health conditions feel secure, calm, and organized. [learn more](GNS314_U5_T4#GNS314_U5_T4_h5)

question: Which activity is commonly included in the daily routine of a half-way house?

options.B: Strict solitary confinement in locked rooms
options.C: Mandatory bed rest for twenty-four hours
options.D: Shared morning chores and group meetings

explanation: Spot on! Daily schedules feature teamwork activities like shared chores and meetings to encourage social interaction and cooperation. [learn more](GNS314_U5_T4#GNS314_U5_T4_h5)

question: What is a major duty of a psychiatric nurse working in a half-way house?

options.A: Monitoring medication adherence and watching for relapse signs
options.B: Performing complex neurosurgeries in the facility parlor
options.C: Cooking all meals for the residents every single day
options.D: Managing the financial accounts of the entire housing estate

explanation: You got it! As a nurse here, your superpower is helping residents stay on track with their medications and catching any early warning signs of a relapse. [learn more](GNS314_U5_T4#GNS314_U5_T4_h6)

question: How does nursing care in a half-way house differ from an acute hospital ward?

options.A: It focuses on rehabilitation, education, and community reintegration
options.B: It requires nurses to diagnose patients without a doctor present
options.C: It forbids nurses from talking to patients about their feelings
options.D: It relies entirely on physical restraints and locked isolation cells

explanation: Correct! Instead of dealing with emergency crises, residential nursing is all about teaching coping skills, guiding rehabilitation, and helping patients reconnect with society. [learn more](GNS314_U5_T4#GNS314_U5_T4_h6)

question: What is a major social challenge faced by half-way houses in Nigeria?

options.A: Excessive public demand for luxury hotel-style rooms
options.B: Stigma leading to community resistance against facility locations
options.C: Too many trained psychiatrists wanting to work in the homes
options.D: An overabundance of government funding and free resources

explanation: True. Deep-seated cultural stigma often makes neighbors uneasy or resistant when a mental health facility tries to open in their neighborhood. [learn more](GNS314_U5_T4#GNS314_U5_T4_h7)

question: Which strategy helps address community resistance toward half-way houses?

options.A: Public health education and community sensitization
options.B: Building high electric fences with armed military guards
options.C: Hiding the location of the house from everyone secretly
options.D: Refusing to let residents ever step outside the gate

explanation: Spot on! Educating the public helps clear up myths about mental illness and encourages local communities to welcome recovering individuals with open arms. [learn more](GNS314_U5_T4#GNS314_U5_T4_h7)

question: What indicates a successful outcome for a resident leaving a half-way house?

options.A: An inability to manage basic finances without supervision
options.B: The ability to maintain stability and live independently
options.C: The permanent loss of all contact with family members
options.D: A court order requiring them to return to hospital wards

explanation: You're doing great! Success means the resident can handle everyday life, look after their health, and thrive outside structured care. [learn more](GNS314_U5_T4#GNS314_U5_T4_h8)

question: A resident is scheduled for discharge next month. What should the care team arrange before departure?

options.A: Termination of all follow-up medical care
options.B: Immediate readmission to an acute psychiatric ward
options.C: Outpatient therapy appointments and secure housing
options.D: A police record check for employment eligibility

explanation: Wonderful! Good discharge planning means setting up safe housing and ongoing outpatient support beforehand to ensure a smooth transition and prevent relapse. [learn more](GNS314_U5_T4#GNS314_U5_T4_h8)
